$comment: Dependency budgets: the runtime-dependency allowlist per package in this repo,
enforced in CI by scripts/check-dependency-budget.mjs (root script: npm run check:budgets).
Each budget restates a decision of record, cited per entry — growing a budget
means changing the decision (ADR-level), not just editing this file.
Scope: `dependencies` only; devDependencies (build/test tooling) are unbudgeted.
Same format as the sibling file in typedstandards; the checker is a copy of that repo's.

packages.name: @typedstandards/civic-typed-harness
packages.source: ADR-0022 §E as amended by its 2026-08-02 addendum — produce-core 0.2.0 re-exports the harness's whole consumption set (sha256Hex, isBlobRef, the canonicalization-rule URIs, PROFILE_CAPTURE_VOCAB, CaptureMethod), so the harness declares exactly ONE runtime dependency, @typedstandards/produce-core ^0.2.0, and imports nothing undeclared. verify-core arrives transitively and must NOT be declared or imported directly (docs/adr/0022-civic-typed-harness-packaging.md).
